svg.title: C18-M02-F1: RAG pipeline with access control
svg.desc: Documents are audited and indexed with ACLs; queries are filtered by the user's ACL before ranking and placed in the context.
svg.text: C18-M02-F1 RAG pipeline with access control
ingest: docs -> audit (ACL, PII, imported text) -> chunks + ACL -> index
query (user U) -> filter chunks by U's ACL -> rank top-k -> context -> model
Figure C18-M02-F1. Authorise before ranking; audit before indexing.
